applications.name: Oracle E-Business Suite (Accounts Payable)
applications.description: System of record for supplier approval, bank account assignment, invoice validation and payment eligibility. Custom forms coexist with standard supplier and AP workbenches.

applications.name: Treasury Payment Hub
applications.description: Receives eligible AP payment proposals, assembles payment runs, obtains dual approval, transfers bank files and reconciles acknowledgements/returns.

applications.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud (Supplier Intake CRM)
applications.description: Captures supplier intent, due diligence, risk review and outbound supplier creation requests. CRM records use a provisional Supplier Reference until the ERP returns its supplier number.

applications.name: Custom Procurement Portal (Supplier Self-Service)
applications.description: Invited suppliers register, upload compliance documents, enter bank details and track status. The portal stores a submission copy and sends normalized data to CRM and EBS.

screens.name: SCR-02.02.02 Payment Eligibility
screens.purpose: Determine whether invoice can be exported to Treasury Hub.
screens.businessProcess: Evaluate holds; refresh eligibility; mark exportable
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Eligibility snapshot authoritative for 30 minutes.
validationRules: Invoice ID must be an existing AP invoice ID
Supplier Number derived from invoice
Bank Account ID references verified account
Eligible Flag true only if all gates pass

screens.name: SCR-02.01.03 Bank Account Assignment
screens.purpose: Assign and verify a supplier bank account for payment use.
screens.businessProcess: Add account; verify account; select primary
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Verifier and supplier-master approver must be distinct.
validationRules: Supplier Number exists and is Active
Account Name matches verified evidence
Account Number is tokenized; confirm match
Routing Code passes country checksum/pattern
Currency enabled for operating unit
One primary account per currency
Verification Status is Pending, Verified or Rejected

screens.name: SCR-02.01.01 Supplier Approval
screens.purpose: Approve, return or reject a proposed supplier master.
screens.businessProcess: Approve supplier; return for correction; assign supplier number
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Approver cannot approve own request; high-risk supplier needs second reviewer.
validationRules: Supplier Reference must exist in inbound staging
Legal Name compared with evidence
Tax Reference unique in operating unit unless waiver
Approval Decision: Approve, Return, Reject
Approver ID is the authenticated EBS user
ERP Supplier Number assigned on approval
Comments required for Return/Reject

screens.name: SCR-04.02.01 Bank File Monitor
screens.purpose: Monitor file creation, transfer and bank acknowledgements.
screens.businessProcess: Transmit file; inspect ack; retry only when transfer is proven absent
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Retransmission requires proof original was not accepted.
exceptionHandling: SFTP times out after remote write
validationRules: File ID must be a unique hub file ID
Run ID must be a released payment run
File Name format HUB_yyyymmdd_ccy_seq.txt
Transfer Status one of Queued, Sent, Acked, Rejected, Unknown
File Hash is SHA-256 hex

screens.name: SCR-01.01.01 Supplier Request
screens.purpose: Capture initial supplier request and allocate a stable provisional reference.
screens.businessProcess: Create draft; validate request; submit for due diligence
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Requester can submit; return requires reviewer comment.
exceptionHandling: Duplicate tax reference search is advisory; draft may save with duplicate warning.
upstreamSystems: Supplier invitation or business sponsor email
validationRules: Supplier Legal Name: 2-180 characters; no edge whitespace
Supplier Type: Goods, Services, Clinical Site, Other
Tax Reference: country pattern by legal entity
Requester: active employee
Expected Annual Spend: non-negative; currency required over zero
Need-By Date: not earlier than request unless override
Request Status: Draft, Submitted, Returned, ERP Pending, Complete

screens.name: SCR-04.01.02 Approval Queue
screens.purpose: Apply maker-checker approval before file release.
screens.businessProcess: Approve run; reject run; request correction
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Dual approval threshold configurable; release rechecks identity.
exceptionHandling: Aliases may map to the same directory ID
validationRules: Run must be validated and not expired
Approver must differ from maker
Approval Decision one of Approve, Reject, Request Changes
Approval Comment required for reject/request changes
Total Amount is sum of lines
Approval Timestamp is server timestamp

screens.name: SCR-03.01.02 Document Upload
screens.purpose: Upload and classify compliance evidence.
screens.businessProcess: Upload document; inspect scan; replace rejected evidence
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Quarantined files hidden downstream until security releases.
validationRules: Submission ID owned by supplier session
Document Type: Tax, Bank Proof, Insurance, Quality, Other
File Size max 15 MB
Malware Scan: Pending, Clear, Quarantined, Error
Document Expiry required for insurance/quality cert
Upload Comment max 500 chars

screens.name: SCR-04.01.03 Payment Exceptions
screens.purpose: Investigate invalid, held or returned payment lines.
screens.businessProcess: Assign exception; record cause; requeue or close
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Critical exception needs Treasury lead acknowledgement.
exceptionHandling: Requeue creates new payment ref while old invoice looks eligible
validationRules: Exception ID must be a unique exception reference
Run ID must reference an existing run
Exception Code one of BANK_REJECT, DUP_REF, AMOUNT, TIMEOUT, OTHER
Severity one of Critical, High, Medium, Low
Assigned To must be an active Treasury user
Resolution Status one of Open, Investigating, Requeued, Closed

screens.name: SCR-01.01.03 Intake Work Queue
screens.purpose: Triage inbound requests and assign coordinators by aging and risk.
screens.businessProcess: Filter work; reassign request; open aging activity
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Team lead assigns; coordinator edits permitted queues only.
exceptionHandling: Saved filters may retain stale statuses; counts refresh after reload.
validationRules: Queue Name: Open, Aging, Returned, ERP Pending
Supplier Reference: exact or prefix search
Created From must be <= Created To
Created To must be >= Created From
Assigned Coordinator: active coordinator
Age (Days): non-negative days
Queue Status: Open, Returned, ERP Pending, Complete

screens.name: SCR-01.02.02 ERP Handoff Monitor
screens.purpose: Track outbound requests and ERP responses by correlation ID.
screens.businessProcess: Inspect handoff; retry publish; acknowledge callback
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Retry transient statuses only; business validation needs correction.
validationRules: Supplier Reference: exact request reference
Correlation ID: UUID from publisher
Publish Status: Ready, Sent, Retry, Failed, Acknowledged
ERP Supplier Number: filled after acknowledgement
Last Attempt: server timestamp
Retry Count: 0–9
Response Message: sanitized response

screens.name: SCR-02.01.02 Supplier Profile
screens.purpose: Maintain approved supplier master and payment terms.
screens.businessProcess: Update profile; hold supplier; inspect history
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: On Hold is immediate; exported payment lines are not automatically cancelled.
validationRules: Supplier Number is a unique ERP supplier identifier
Legal Name 2-180 characters
Supplier Status: Active, On Hold, Inactive
Payment Terms allowed for operating unit
Operating Unit is an authorized ledger context
Tax Reference matches approved source
Last Changed By is the authenticated EBS user

screens.name: SCR-03.02.02 Resubmission Center
screens.purpose: Resolve returned submission and replace requested evidence.
screens.businessProcess: Replace evidence; resubmit; inspect acknowledgement
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Only requested checklist item reopens unless compliance lead resets package.
exceptionHandling: No owner for manual retry after third callback failure
validationRules: Submission ID must be owned submission in Returned state
Return Reason: Bank proof, Tax mismatch, Missing form, Other
Replacement File required for evidence return reason
Supplier Comment max 1,000 chars
Resubmission Status: Draft, Sent, Acknowledged, Error

screens.name: SCR-03.02.01 Submission Status
screens.purpose: Show current registration and approval stages externally.
screens.businessProcess: View stage; read message; open action item
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Only approved non-sensitive messages visible externally.
exceptionHandling: Callback order can move stage backward
Estimated date may remain during hold
validationRules: Submission ID must be exact owned submission
Current Stage: Draft, Review, ERP Approval, Bank Verify, Complete
Message to Supplier uses approved template
Estimated Completion is guidance only, not SLA

screens.name: SCR-02.02.01 Invoice Workbench
screens.purpose: Enter and validate invoices before eligibility.
screens.businessProcess: Create invoice; validate; apply/release hold
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Invoices over USD 50,000 need supervisor review.
upstreamSystems: Supplier master and PO reference feed
validationRules: Invoice Number unique per supplier; leading zeros count
Supplier Number is an active supplier in operating unit
Invoice Date not older than 180 days without override
Amount positive with max 2 decimals
Currency matches supplier/payment configuration
Bank Account ID required before eligibility
Validation Status is New, Valid, Hold or Rejected

screens.name: SCR-01.02.01 Risk Review
screens.purpose: Determine whether a supplier can be handed to ERP approval.
screens.businessProcess: Review risk; apply override; authorize handoff
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Critical risk requires compliance lead sign-off.
validationRules: Supplier Reference: must resolve to request
Risk Score: 0 to 100 after evidence weighting
Risk Band: Low, Moderate, High, Critical
Override Reason: required if band differs from calculated band
Decision: Proceed, Hold, Return
Decision Owner: risk reviewer with override permission
Decision Timestamp: server timestamp

screens.name: SCR-03.01.01 Registration Wizard
screens.purpose: Create supplier submission through a guided flow.
screens.businessProcess: Create draft; validate registration; submit base profile
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Final submit waits for mandatory evidence.
validationRules: Invitation Token valid until expiry
Legal Entity Name 2-180 characters
Country from enabled country list
Tax Reference follows country-specific pattern
Contact Email verified, no shared mailbox
Supplier Category: Goods, Services, Clinical, Other
Save Status: Draft, In Progress, Submitted

screens.name: SCR-01.01.02 Due Diligence Checklist
screens.purpose: Collect evidence checks used by supplier operations and compliance.
screens.businessProcess: Record check; attach evidence; calculate checklist completion
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Concern requires risk analyst review before ERP handoff.
validationRules: Supplier Reference: must exist in Supplier_Request__c
Check Type: Tax, Sanctions, Insurance, Quality, Conflict
Review Result: Pending, Clear, Concern, N/A
Reviewer: Compliance or Supplier Ops
Evidence Link: HTTPS URL or managed document key
Reviewed Date: required when result is not Pending
Reviewer Notes: max 2,000 chars

screens.name: SCR-04.01.01 Payment Run Builder
screens.purpose: Create payment run from AP-eligible invoice proposals.
screens.businessProcess: Create run; validate totals; submit for dual approval
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Maker cannot approve own run; high value needs lead/controller.
validationRules: Run Name unique per execution date
Execution Date must respect business day and cut-off rules
One currency per run
Payment Method must be ACH-Test, Wire-Test or Manual
Source Batch ID must exist and be unconsumed
At least one eligible line
Run Status one of Draft, Validated, Pending Approval, Released

screens.name: SCR-03.01.03 Bank Details
screens.purpose: Capture payment account data for later EBS verification.
screens.businessProcess: Capture bank details; validate confirmation; submit verification request
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Changes after final submission require resubmission and fresh approval.
exceptionHandling: EBS acknowledgement may time out after save
validationRules: Submission ID owned by current supplier session
Account Holder Name matches bank proof
Account Number 8-34 chars; confirmation must match
Confirm Account Number exact match; never clear-text stored
Bank Name 2-120 characters
Routing Code country-specific pattern
Account Currency supported by payment hub

screens.name: SCR-04.02.02 Reconciliation
screens.purpose: Match hub payment lines against bank confirmations and returns.
screens.businessProcess: Match bank status; create break; mark reconciled
workflowSteps: Review source values and validation output.
screens.approvalLogic: Manual match over USD 10,000 requires controller approval.
exceptionHandling: partial settlements not aggregated on first load
validationRules: Run ID must be a released run in settlement window
Bank Reference must be exact ack or return reference
Difference Amount = hub amount minus bank-confirmed amount
Hub Status one of Released, Sent, Confirmed, Returned
Bank Status one of Accepted, Settled, Returned, Unknown
Reconciliation Status one of Matched, Break, Pending Review

metadata.errorHandling: Parse known codes; unrecognized codes remain Unknown for operations review.

components.description: Supplier request publication from CRM to Accounts Payable.

metadata.payload: Supplier request, risk band, document references, correlation ID
metadata.errorHandling: 4xx returned to coordinator; 5xx retries 3 times; dead-letter dashboard checked daily.
